description:
Found at an undisclosed in Mexico, this is a mind blowing relic of history. It is comprised of two stones that emit a orange light when correctly fitted together. The main body is one solid piece of stone with no holes or ports whatsoever. The smaller piece is solid stone with what we believe is a crystal fastened to it. ￼ both pieces have visible metal attachments that seem to be welded or smelted directly into the stone. 

I am a licensed electrician who has lived on renewable energy for over three years and have a deep understanding of energy as a being, but I am at a loss to explain this. I believe it runs off of magnetic or frequency energy, possibly piezoelectric. 

The craziest thing is how these artifacts seem to have a mind of their own, often times shutting off instantly when certain people walk in a room or not wanting to emit light while being recorded. I have a lot more to figure out on these and would welcome any sincere qualified opinions.
-Joe￼
